name: What are the benefits of adding an in-law suite to my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding an in-law suite to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding an in-law suite offers several advantages for homeowners. It provides a private and comfortable space for aging parents or adult children, fostering family togetherness while maintaining individual independence. Beyond family use, an ADU can generate rental income, serve as a dedicated home office, or function as a guest house, enhancing property utility. Additionally, a well-designed in-law suite can increase your property value, making it an attractive feature for future buyers seeking flexible living arrangements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include providing independent living for family, generating rental income, increasing property value, or serving as a versatile space like a home office or guest house.
